name: Rhendara
description: Rhendara burns at the edge of charted space, its light reaching survey scopes long before any hull. Its worlds formed late from enriched debris, and their crusts still carry the ratio of that violent birth. The guild maintains a listening post here, though no report has ever named its purpose.

stars.name: Cold Hammer
stars.description: A G-class star burning yellow, the dependable engine of its court. Surface granulation churns visibly, and flare seasons come like clockwork. Long-baseline scopes watch it for the cycle that precedes its next active phase.

planets.name: Shallowholm
planets.description: Dune seas bury everything but the oldest basalt spires. The wind never stops, and the sand sings at dusk through the canyons. A derelict relay drifts at the edge, still warm, still broadcasting nothing.

moons.name: Quartz Gravel II
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Its surface records every era of bombardment the system ever knew. Outgassing vents frost the trailing face a little more each orbit.

planets.name: Calmholm
planets.description: Nitrogen glaciers creep under a sky the color of old bone. Geysers of sublimating ice erupt along the terminator line. A derelict relay drifts at the edge, still warm, still broadcasting nothing.

planets.name: Broadwold
planets.description: Lava lakes breathe through a fractured crust, resurfacing yearly. Sulfur frost rims the high ground between the glowing rifts. A standing bounty covers any intact core sample from the second planet outward.

dwarfPlanets.name: Cinder Outer 16
dwarfPlanets.description: A small cold world holding its round shape against the dark. Frost plains stretch unbroken to a horizon that curves too soon. Its thin story is written entirely in impact craters.

asteroids.description: A tumbling rock with a scarred face and a patient spin. Its regolith hides metal concentrations the assays prize. Outgassing cracks suggest ice beneath the dust mantle.

belts.name: Cinder Trojans
belts.description: Countless fragments grind slowly against each other in a broad torus. Collisional dust hazes the lane, and larger bodies keep eccentric courts. Old mining claims dot the denser knots, most of them long expired.

comets.name: Late Shroud 5
comets.description: A dirty snowball falling sunward on its long appointed round. Each passage sheds glittering debris the scopes track for seasons. Its tail leans away from the star like a banner in a gale.
